figurative_meaning_en: A Dom (a member of the Dom caste involved in cremations); a person who handles corpses; a pallbearer
example_sentences_in_bangla: গঙ্গার তীরে গঙ্গাপুত্ররা মৃতদেহের দাহ করে।
সে গঙ্গাপুত্র হিসেবে পরিচিত, মৃতদেহ বহন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: On the banks of the Ganges, the sons of Ganga perform cremations.
He is known as a son of Ganga, handling the transport of corpses.
history: The term refers to the Dom community, a Scheduled Caste in India historically associated with cremation duties along the Ganges River, rooted in ancient Hindu practices of riverine funerals.
note: This expression carries connotations of social stigma due to caste associations but holds reverence in ritual contexts.
